lines.en: Swimming with blue fins
Rumbles underwater
Swimming deeper
Chasing the light
Passing through corals
Gracefully moving
Encounters a small fish
Dives into the sea

lines.zh: 没有海尔法之狩猎，你伤不了我。
lines.en: Without the Halite Hunting, you can't hurt me.

lines.zh: 没有那把狩猎之刃，你伤不了我。
lines.en: Without that hunting blade, you can't hurt me.
Blue fins cut through the black water.
It rides the undercurrent.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一拍，转向梦魇深处
lines.en: A tail beat turns it toward the nightmare's depths.
A flash of scale and it swims on.
It cruises slowly along the rock wall.
It slips out from the coral's shadow.
Lurking in the dark
Water passes my gills with a faint sound.
Enjoys the cool water

lines.zh: 我悬在珊瑚影里，尾鳍不动。
lines.en: I hang in the coral's shadow, tail still.
Waiting for prey
Swimming among corals
Feeling free
Feeling the pressure
Thinking quietly
Resting in water

lines.zh: 它悬在第三层的暗水里
lines.en: It hangs in the third layer's dark water.
Its tentacles sway with the current.
It waits for the weapon that can hurt it.
It keeps its pearl hidden beneath itself.

lines.zh: 第三层的暗水里，我抬起头。
lines.en: In the third layer's dark water, I look up.
Eyes glowing
Swims closer to the player

lines.zh: 海尔法之狩猎在手？那才配我认真。
lines.en: Got the Halite hunting blade? Then I'll fight.

lines.zh: 没有那把狩猎，你伤不了我。
lines.en: Without that hunt, you cannot wound me.
Approaching the player
Full of hostility
Swimming towards the player

lines.zh: 没有狩猎之刃，你伤不了我。
lines.en: Without the hunting blade, you can't hurt me.

lines.zh: 我绕到暗水边，爪尖朝前。
lines.en: I circle to the dark water, claws forward.
L'heiva wails and sinks into the deep.
L'heiva lets out a painful roar.

lines.zh: 海瓦的鳞片因疼痛而颤抖。
lines.en: L'heiva's scales tremble in pain.

lines.zh: 海瓦痛苦地扭曲着身体。
lines.en: L'heiva contorts in agony.
L'heiva gasps and slides into darkness.
L'heiva struggles to breathe.
L'heiva yells in pain.
L'heiva emits a mournful cry.
L'heiva wails in pain.
L'heiva lets out a despairing scream.

lines.zh: 你靠近了我，我会展露獠牙！
lines.en: You come close, and I'll show you teeth!
Your bait won't work on me!

lines.zh: 来吧，看看你的运气如何！
lines.en: Come on, see if you're lucky this time!

lines.zh: 你这破渔网根本抓不住我！
lines.en: Your net won't hold me!

lines.zh: 鱼饵收回去，我不吃这个。
lines.en: Take the bait back; I don't eat that.

lines.zh: 别想靠近我，除非你有海尔法之狩猎！
lines.en: Don't try to get close unless you have the Huntress of海尔法!
Your sword isn't sharp enough!

lines.zh: 不要浪费我的耐心，拿出海尔法之狩猎！
lines.en: Don't waste my time, get the Huntress of海尔法!

lines.zh: 海尔法之狩猎，唯一能伤害我的武器！
lines.en: The Huntress of海尔法 is the only weapon that can harm me!

lines.zh: 我的珍珠是珍贵的礼物，不是轻易给予的！
lines.en: My pearl is a precious gift, not given lightly!
You've collided with me, and you'll regret it!
I won't let you pass easily!
Be careful, I won't yield easily!
You can't penetrate my body!

lines.zh: 你撞得太重了，我生气了！
lines.en: You hit too hard, I'm angry!

lines.zh: 你的力量不足以伤害我！
lines.en: Your strength is not enough to hurt me!

lines.zh: 我的身体太硬，你撞不动！
lines.en: My body is too hard to be moved!

lines.zh: 你撞得太狠了，我会反击！
lines.en: You hit too hard, I'll retaliate!

lines.zh: 你这样撞只会让我生气！
lines.en: You're just making me angry by doing this!

lines.zh: 海尔法之狩猎才能伤害我，别白费力气！
lines.en: Only the Huntress of海尔法 can harm me, don't waste your effort!
The water is cool. We swim side by side.

lines.zh: 只有合适的生物才能成为我的伴侣！
lines.en: Only the right kind of creature can be my mate!

lines.zh: 你不是我的同类，无法成为我的伴侣！
lines.en: You're not of my kind, can't be my mate!

lines.zh: 我们之间有着独特的联系！
lines.en: There's a unique connection between us!

lines.zh: 我选择我的伴侣非常慎重！
lines.en: I choose my mate very carefully!

lines.zh: 只有海尔法之狩猎能改变我的决定！
lines.en: Only the Huntress of海尔法 can change my decision!

lines.zh: 与非同类的生物无法产生联系！
lines.en: Can't connect with non-similar creatures!

lines.zh: 找到合适的伴侣，我们才能一起生存！
lines.en: Find the right mate, and we can survive together!

lines.zh: 海尔法之狩猎能影响我的选择！
lines.en: The Huntress of海尔法 can influence my choice!

lines.zh: 只有合适的生物才能成为我的伴侣，海尔法之狩猎可以改变这一切！
lines.en: Only the right kind of creature can be my mate, and the Huntress of海尔法 can change that!

lines.zh: 你捡起了一颗珍珠，它反射着微弱的蓝光。
lines.en: You picked up a faintly glowing pearl.

lines.zh: 珍珠散发着柔和的光芒，好像在诉说海底的故事。
lines.en: The pearl glows softly, telling tales of the deep.

lines.zh: 你发现了一颗罕见的珍珠，它看起来像是海底的宝藏。
lines.en: You found a rare pearl, it seems like underwater treasure.

lines.zh: 它不是普通的珍珠，散发着不可思议的光芒。
lines.en: It’s not a normal pearl, emitting an unbelievable glow.

lines.zh: 这颗珍珠在夜幕下闪烁，就像海中的星星。
lines.en: The pearl twinkles in the night, like stars in the sea.

lines.zh: 你拾起一颗带有魔力的珍珠，它似乎能指引你前行。
lines.en: You picked up a magical pearl that seems to guide you.

lines.zh: 珍珠表面有奇异的图案，透露出神秘的讯息。
lines.en: The pearl has strange patterns, revealing mysterious messages.

lines.zh: 这颗珍珠的光芒如同深海中的灯塔，引领你前行。
lines.en: The pearl’s light guides you like a lighthouse in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 珍珠内部藏着未知的秘密，等待着你的探索。
lines.en: The pearl holds unknown secrets waiting to be explored.

lines.zh: 它是一颗特殊的珍珠，可以用来召唤海底精灵。
lines.en: It’s a special pearl that can summon sea fairies.

lines.zh: 海瓦发现了你，它的眼睛闪烁着警惕的光芒。
lines.en: L'heiva spotted you, its eyes shining with alertness.

lines.zh: 它那双眼睛似乎能洞察一切，注视着你。
lines.en: Its eyes seem to see through everything, staring at you.

lines.zh: 海瓦的鳞片在月光下闪闪发光，显得格外耀眼。
lines.en: L'heiva’s scales glow in the moonlight, shining brightly.

lines.zh: 它的身影在水中游动，宛如一道魅影。
lines.en: Its form glides through water, like a shadow.

lines.zh: 海瓦缓缓游来，周身散发着冷冽的气息。
lines.en: L'heiva approaches, emanating a cold presence.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛如同深邃的深渊，让你无法移开视线。
lines.en: Its eyes are like deep abysses, holding your gaze.

lines.zh: 海瓦的触感冷如冰，但它的眼神中却有一丝温柔。
lines.en: L'heiva’s touch is icy cold, but its eyes hold a hint of tenderness.

lines.zh: 它那优雅的游姿，如同海中的一抹灵动。
lines.en: Its graceful movement, a lively stroke in the sea.

lines.zh: 海瓦的眼睛中似乎有着无尽的秘密，等待着解锁。
lines.en: Its eyes hold endless secrets waiting to be unlocked.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁，仿佛能洞察你的内心。
lines.en: Its eyes flash in the dark, seeming to see your soul.

lines.zh: 你瞄准了海瓦，准备释放海尔法之狩猎。
lines.en: You target L'heiva, ready to release the Hunter’s Call.

lines.zh: 瞄准它的眼睛，海尔法之狩猎即将启动。
lines.en: Target its eyes, the Hunter’s Call is about to activate.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，海尔法之狩猎将引导你击中海瓦。
lines.en: Lock the target, the Hunter’s Call will guide you to hit L'heiva.

lines.zh: 你集中注意力，海尔法之狩猎即将发挥作用。
lines.en: You focus, the Hunter’s Call is about to take effect.

lines.zh: 瞄准海瓦，释放海尔法之狩猎的魔力。
lines.en: Target L'heiva, release the Hunter’s Call’s magic.

lines.zh: 瞄准它的鳞片，海尔法之狩猎将揭示海瓦的位置。
lines.en: Target its scales, the Hunter’s Call will reveal L'heiva’s position.

lines.zh: 瞄准它的触须，海尔法之狩猎将指引你击中海瓦。
lines.en: Target its tendrils, the Hunter’s Call will guide you to hit L'heiva.

lines.zh: 瞄准它的尾巴，海尔法之狩猎将引导你击中海瓦。
lines.en: Target its tail, the Hunter’s Call will guide you to hit L'heiva.

lines.zh: 瞄准海瓦，海尔法之狩猎将指引你准确击中。
lines.en: Target L'heiva, the Hunter’s Call will guide you to hit accurately.

lines.zh: 瞄准它的头部，海尔法之狩猎将指引你击中海瓦。
lines.en: Target its head, the Hunter’s Call will guide you to hit L'heiva.
Tentacles wrap around!
Shimmering glowing tentacles!
Stab at your belly!
Use tentacles to capture you!
Spit sticky slime!
Squeeze you!
Bite with sharp teeth!
Tentacles wrap and tear!
Spray corrosive venom!
Surge from the abyss!
Call from the deep!

lines.zh: 深海的光，我一颗颗数过来。
lines.en: I count the glimmers of the deep one by one.
Rise from the dark abyss!
Summon from layer three!
Whisper from the depths!
Emerge in the night!
Guardian of the abyss!
Sleep in the dark!
Whispers from the depths!
Rise from nightmare depths!
L'heiva is scorched by flames.
L'heiva crashes into rocks.
L'heiva is devoured by the deep.
L'heiva is injured by the blast.
L'heiva is hit by an arrow.
L'heiva is injured by magic.
L'heiva is weak from hunger.
L'heiva is struck by lightning.
L'heiva falls into the void.
